verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, but none of the cited material mentions general ledger, ledger-account, journal-entry or trial-balance endpoints or exports. The documented resources (contacts, webhooks, subscriptions) are adjacent and do not show this capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
